name: r1_abs
change: MLP predicts log trip energy directly (physics integrals only as inputs); RoadSim physics v2, raw simulated energy

name: r2_corr
change: predict a correction to the generic road-load physics estimate

name: r3_lab
change: RoadSim's OBD label model (roadsim.obd.label_fuel: MAF fuel-cut air, missed enrichment) for MAF-estimated fuel; flag input

name: r4_rw
change: v1's dev-fitted on-road loads wrapper on top of v2 (v2 already carries its own on-road load)

name: r5_phev
change: v1's plug-in hardware patch on the generated plug-ins (pack power >= 1.2 x motor, resistance / 2.5, MG2 torque x 1.8); dev twin read: the network put the dev plug-ins 33% above their own RoadSim twins

name: r5b_labphev
change: both near-misses together: RoadSim's OBD label model (r3) and the plug-in patch (r5), each of which improved D2 by just under 0.01 alone

name: r6_ens
change: ensemble of 5 networks (seeds); sigma includes their spread

name: r7_era
change: model-year input (VED: fueleconomy.gov models matched to the car; EPA: test year); the fleet's engine efficiency follows the fueleconomy.gov dev era trend, so the network can tell a 2006 car from a 2022 one

name: r8_epahyb
change: EPA test-car hybrids told their hybrid system (P2 / power-split / series, from the model line; RoadSim's public spec-sheet table) instead of 'power-split' for all; the same networks

name: r9_bus
change: ZTBus told the trolleybus's published curb mass (19 t, 'reported' mass) instead of the class prior (15 t); the same networks

name: r9b_inputs
change: both public-spec inputs together (r8 EPA hybrid system + r9 bus curb mass), each short of the margin alone

name: r10_epalab
change: simulated window-sticker labels by RoadSim's EPA procedure emulation (FTP-75 with hot soak, hybrids preconditioned and corrected for net battery energy) instead of fleet.py's shortcut; physics rung (labels change)

name: r11_big
change: GPU: twice the simulated data (a second bank of 28,800 trips on the same fleet, new seed), wider networks (512 units, 0.73M weights each) and 100 epochs

name: r11b_data
change: twice the simulated data only (both banks, 57,600 trips), networks and training as r7

name: r13_data3
change: three times the simulated data (three banks on the same fleet, 86,400 trips), networks and training as r7

name: r14_dyno
change: SC03 and 20 F cold-FTP dynamometer draws run under the EPA test conditions (roadsim.epa: SC03 850 W/m2 sun, A/C maximum on recirculated air at 72 F, cabin soaked to 45 C after a preconditioning drive; cold FTP heat at 72 F on outside air); dev twin read: the network sat 17.5% below the dev SC03 tests while RoadSim's own SC03 twin of 47 dev vehicles is -0.3%; the old bank draw missed 12% of a conventional car's SC03 fuel (median of 13 training vehicles, check_dynoproc.py); physics rung

name: r15_noidle
change: generated conventional light-duty cars without engine idle-stop (RoadSim's generator gave 30% of them idle-stop at any model year, invisible to the network; RoadSim's dev-calibrated twins have none and match the dev FTP within 1.4%); their rows re-simulated on the same trips and start states, labels recomputed; dev twin read: the network put RoadSim's own twins of 60 dev EPA cars 5.5% low on the UDDS and 0.8% low on the HWFET, and the dev FTP 3.9% low while the highway is +0.4%; physics rung, on top of r14's banks

name: r16_inputs
change: the incumbent's networks told two public-spec inputs, each rejected alone on r7: the EPA test-car hybrids' system (r8) and the ZTBus curb mass (r9); gate-only rung

name: r17_noidle_inputs
change: r15's networks (SC03 / cold-FTP test conditions and no idle-stop) with r16's two public-spec inputs; physics rung against the incumbent (planned before r15 was scored)

name: r18_robust
change: repair rung (audit 25 Nov 2026): r17's recipe and banks, the 5 networks retrained with percentile-clipped input statistics (train.py --robust-norm: each column clipped to its 0.5-99.5 percentiles before the mean and sd) and the component loss masked like the NLL (--mask-comp); v2.1's scaling had left four work-share inputs (aero, rolling, downhill grade, inertia over Ep) at sd 0.00002-0.00005 on real trips
